title: Using this guide
lead: Try Bitmovin Player in Player Lab, then follow the implementation guide for your platform.

blocks.text: Player Lab currently uses Bitmovin Player. Settings and controls differ by platform. Try the public Web app first, then choose the guide for the app you will use.

items: Open the public Web app. Select the language switch at the top if you want Japanese. The initial VOD HLS source is a 60-second Big Buck Bunny clip with muted audio. Press Play if playback does not start automatically.
Keep the same video, select Default (Bitmovin), then switch to Neon. Compare the colors and control-bar appearance and inspect the construction code beside or below the video.
To try other settings or sources, continue to Web: Screen and controls below. Apply one change at a time and check the video, event log and applied code.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: A theme named Live does not select a live source. Construction code shows the selected theme rather than exporting all settings. The short public clips cannot demonstrate a long rewind window or chapter markers at 120 seconds and beyond.

blocks.caption: The public Web app. Select a theme at the top and inspect its construction code beside the video. The layout changes with the screen width.

blocks.text: Choose your platform below. Screen and controls explains the app workflow; Implementation guide explains SDK calls, configuration and UI changes. Try an operation, then use the same platform’s implementation guide to inspect the code. SDK property names and code retain their original notation. Check each input’s unit, such as seconds, milliseconds or bit/s.
